response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems, high-throughput architectures, and crucially, AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators. While he lacks the required Python experience, his mastery of TypeScript, systems design, and direct experience building frameworks for agentic workflows make him an exceptionally strong candidate for an AI-native engineering organization. His background demonstrates the exact mindset and technical strategy capabilities required for this role, making him worth interviewing despite the language gap.
strengths: Direct hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and frameworks for agentic workflows (MCP).
Proven track record designing high-throughput distributed systems handling millions of requests per second.
Extensive Staff-level and founder experience demonstrating strong ownership, systems thinking, and architectural mastery.
concerns: No professional Python experience listed on the resume, which is a must-have technical requirement.
Highly varied tech stack history (DLang, Node.js, C++) might indicate a longer ramp-up in a specialized Python environment.
Limited explicit mention of standard agile scrum ceremonies (e.g., scrum champion) or on-call rotation management.
